title: Choose the visual world
question: Layout stays. Violet chrome goes. Chrome skins and canvas paper stay separate. Pick the world the chrome is made of.

options.label: Lab enamel caseboard
options.lineage: Hospital / lab baked-enamel status boards, clip strips, magnetic tabs
options.thesis: Chrome is a baked enamel instrument panel around the paper, not a SaaS dashboard.
options.viewport: Same skeleton: top bar, left tool rail, canvas, status. Enamel field, teal header strip, one ochre tab as the live tool, paper in the middle is independent.
options.risk: Clinic teal can read ‘medical app’ if tabs become badges and the board stops looking like a work surface.

options.label: Jet-age ticket wallet
options.lineage: Airline coupon books, carbon copies, baggage stubs
options.thesis: Chrome is coupon stock and stamped legs; the board is the remaining journey.
options.viewport: Same layout. Navy top coupon, red validated stamps on sync/save, hairline fields for zoom and tools, canvas as the unused coupon.
options.risk: Carbon purple and airline red can resurrect accent-slop if they flood the rail.
options.case: Audience ID weaker (airport, not desk). Product clarity decent for status stamps; fuses poorly if VOID/carbon becomes another purple brand.

options.label: Rhythm-machine panel
options.thesis: The tool rail is a silkscreened key row; chrome themes are pattern banks.
options.viewport: Same layout. Charcoal chrome, tools as squat keys in four color quarters, status as a segmented tempo readout, canvas untouched.
options.risk: Reads as a synth plugin; candy keys can toy the board.
options.case: Audience ID mixed (musician). Product clarity strong for theme banks as pattern banks; fuses poorly if chase-light motion fights a still canvas.

options.label: Miura orbit sheet
options.lineage: Deployable Miura-fold solar sails and map packets
options.thesis: Chrome is the gold packet; the canvas is the deployed crease field.
options.viewport: Same layout. Compact gold chrome, pale sheet canvas with scored grid independent of chrome, tools as crease-cell toggles.
options.risk: Aerospace spec can feel like a NASA microsite instead of a desk board.
options.case: Audience ID niche. Product clarity good for independent paper vs packet; fuses poorly if tessellation redraws the skeleton we must keep.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A serious infinite-canvas editor: dark or light chrome, one accent, tool rail, properties in the top bar. FigJam / Excalidraw / Miro craft, no irony.
canonCard.viewport: The current skeleton executed at competitor fidelity: Inter-class UI, quiet gray, one accent, no enamel, no coupons.
canonCard.risk: This is the violet dashboard again if the accent stays purple.
